newsitem.title: USA: Motel fires kills five in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: Motel fires kills five in Colorado.

text.p: A pre-dawn fire in which arson was suspected killed five people in a suburban Denver motel Monday, officials said.
A firefighter battling the blaze was injured, but was released after treatment at an area hospital, the North Metro Fire Rescue Authority said.
The fire at the Hacienda Hotel near Interstate-25 in Thornton, Colorado, was under investigation and arson was suspected, the authority said in a statement.
